## Deterministic Scenarios {#sec-mce_results}

{{< include /_chapters/dsha.results.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-gmm",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("fig.GMPE.PSA"), ID.target = NULL),
    root = root,
    context = "scenario GMM spectra"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/UHS.compare.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-compare",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("fig.UHS.compare"), ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "DSHA comparison"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/Scenarios.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-scenarios",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.Scenarios"), ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "declared scenario parameters"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DSHA.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.DSHA"), ID.target = ID.gmdp, Vs30.target = 760),
    root = root,
    context = "DSHA comparison table"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/Scenarios.PGA.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-scenarios-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.Scenarios.PGA"), ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "scenario PGA by condition"
  )
}
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "i", "SiteTable"
), ls()))
```
